diagnostic_steps.action: Parse log stream for HPA scaling failures
findings: HPA unable to calculate metrics: missing CPU metrics for pods
Metrics server unable to scrape pods due to connection timeout
HPA stuck at 2 replicas despite high load (desired: 10)
Request rate at 5000 req/s with response latency at 3000ms
Metrics server not responding in kube-system namespace
Metrics server pods are running but not serving metrics
No CPU metrics available for web-frontend pods
HPA configured with CPU target at 70%
HPA unable to scale due to missing metrics
Root cause: Metrics server not responding to scrape requests
Contributing factor: Metrics server resource limits too low
Possible network issue between metrics server and kubelet
diagnostic_steps.root_cause: Metrics server failure preventing HPA from scaling

recommendations.command: kubectl rollout restart deployment metrics-server -n kube-system
recommendations.rationale: Restart metrics server to clear any stuck state

recommendations.command: kubectl set resources deployment metrics-server --limits=cpu=500m --memory=500Mi --requests=cpu=100m --memory=100Mi -n kube-system
recommendations.rationale: Increase metrics server resource limits to handle scrape load

recommendations.command: kubectl get pods -n kube-system -l k8s-app=metrics-server -o name | xargs -I {} kubectl logs {} -n kube-system --tail=50
recommendations.rationale: Check metrics server logs for error details
Manually scale to handle immediate load while fixing metrics

recommendations.command:
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: metrics-server-config
  namespace: kube-system
data:
  NannyConfiguration: |
    apiVersion: nanny/v1alpha1
    kind: NannyConfiguration
    source:
      containers:
      - name: metrics-server
    destination:
      containers:
      - name: metrics-server
EOF
recommendations.rationale: Configure metrics server with proper settings

recommendations.command:
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: web-frontend
  namespace: web-frontend
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: web-frontend
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 10
  metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: cpu
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 70
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: memory
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 80
EOF
recommendations.rationale: Update HPA to include memory metrics as fallback

remediation_validation: Verify metrics server is healthy and serving metrics
Test metrics API endpoint returns node and pod metrics
Confirm HPA can scale based on CPU metrics
